transform: none — use raw integer (0=closed autocracy, 1=electoral autocracy, 2=electoral democracy, 3=liberal democracy)
notes: V-Dem Regimes of the World (RoW) 4-category classification. Short-name column is 'regime_row_owid'. Coverage: 1789–2025 for ~180 countries. Drop rows where Code starts with 'OWID_' (regional aggregates). Already in existing fetcher pattern (Entity/Code/Year layout). Treat as ordinal categorical — do NOT treat as continuous.

filter_params: No query params needed — full file. Filter: keep rows where country_text_id is a valid ISO-3 code (not empty). Target column: aut_ep (1 = country is in an active autocratization episode in that year, 0 = not in episode).
notes: V-Dem Episodes of Regime Transformation (ERT) dataset v16. The binary column 'aut_ep' (1=autocratization episode active) is the exact signal requested. Coverage: 1900–2024, ~180 countries. Source file is a GitHub raw CSV (~2MB), no auth. Alternative also exists via OWID ERT grapher (political-regime-ert.csv, column 'regime_trich_ert') but that is a trichotomous type not a binary episode flag — use ERT source directly. country_text_id is ISO-3 uppercase.

filter_params: ?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=false — no additional filter; drop rows where Code is empty or starts with 'OWID_'
transform: per-population: (Ages 15-24 / Total population) * 100 — requires summing all age-group columns to get total OR joining with population-unwpp.csv for total population
derivation: Base series from population-by-age-group.csv: column 'Ages 15-24' (absolute count). Derive share: ages_15_24 / (Under-5s + Ages 5-14 + Ages 15-24 + Ages 25-64 + Ages 65+) * 100. All columns available in same CSV row. Result: % of total population aged 15–24.
notes: UN WPP via OWID. Coverage: 1950–2023 (historical) + projections. Columns in CSV: Entity, Code, Year, Ages 65+, Ages 25-64, Ages 15-24, Ages 5-14, Under-5s — all absolute counts. Youth bulge share = Ages 15-24 / row-sum(all age cols) * 100. Drop OWID_ aggregate rows. No separate OWID grapher publishes the share directly — must compute from absolute counts.

filter_params: ?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=false — no additional filter; drop rows where Code is empty or starts with 'OWID_'
transform: none — standardized Bayesian latent variable score (approx range -2.0 to +2.7; higher = more capable)
notes: Hanson & Sigman (2021) composite Bayesian latent variable index combining 21 indicators across coercive + extractive + administrative dimensions. Short-name column: 'capacity'. Coverage: 1960–2015, 177 countries. Static dataset — no updates expected beyond 2015. Source: Hanson & Sigman via OWID (CC BY 4.0). For sub-dimension scores see OWID_STATECAP_COERCE / _EXTRACT / _ADMIN specs below.

filter_params: Download HansonSigman_source.tab from Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/IFZXQX. File contains capacity estimates and source data. Filter: keep country-year rows; target column is the coercive capacity sub-index (exact column name: 'coerce' based on paper documentation — verify against downloaded header). ISO-3 or COW country code mapping needed.
transform: none — standardized latent variable score (same scale as composite)
notes: Hanson & Sigman coercive capacity sub-dimension: government territorial control + monopoly on force. NOT separately published on OWID grapher — must pull from Harvard Dataverse source file (HansonSigman_source.tab). The QoG database (datafinder.qog.gu.se) exposes only 'lld_capacity' (composite). Sub-dimension column name 'coerce' is inferred from paper codebook — confirm against actual file header on download. Coverage: 1960–2015, 177 countries. Country code field may be COW numeric (ccode) — needs ISO-3 crosswalk.

filter_params: Same file as OWID_STATECAP_COERCE (HansonSigman_source.tab from Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/IFZXQX). Target column: extractive capacity sub-index (exact column name: 'extract' — verify against file header). COW code mapping needed.
notes: Hanson & Sigman extractive capacity sub-dimension: government ability to raise sustainable revenues (tax + non-tax). NOT on OWID grapher separately. Same source file as OWID_STATECAP_COERCE. Column name 'extract' is inferred from paper — confirm on download. Proxy alternative via OWID: 'tax-revenues-as-a-share-of-gdp-unu-wider' (slug) gives UNU-WIDER tax revenue data which is one component, but not the full latent extract score.

filter_params: Same file as OWID_STATECAP_COERCE (HansonSigman_source.tab from Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/IFZXQX). Target column: administrative capacity sub-index (exact column name: 'admin' — verify against file header). COW code mapping needed.
notes: Hanson & Sigman administrative capacity sub-dimension: bureaucratic quality, skilled/impartial public servants. NOT on OWID grapher separately.
